generationContract.sourceRetention: The accepted 1254px master remains under tmp/imagegen/v039-second-pass/fear-incap in this worktree.

assets.mechanic: A shared incapacitating-fear aura emitted by player and mob effects after the wire summary has discarded the original source.
assets.intendedVisualSubject: One terrified victim face compressed by inward-curling cyan-violet shadow pressure, with frightened eyes and a restrained crimson mouth accent.

references.role: Spectral fear palette and victim expression only, without copying class identity.
Small-scale screaming-face readability and violet energy finish only.
Current aura-family paint density and cyan-violet separation.
Current hostile-aura darkness, pressure, and restrained crimson accent.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1:1 dark-fantasy MMORPG aura/debuff UI icon, ultimately displayed at 13, 16, 28, and 40 pixels.
Paint the shared incapacitating-fear aura used truthfully across Warlock Harrow, area fear spells, monster Dread, and monster Terrify.
One large centered gender-neutral terrified victim face, eyes and mouth open in panic, engulfed and compressed by inward-curling shadow pressure and spectral fear waves; the face itself is the unmistakable focal silhouette.
Premium hand-painted dark-fantasy MMORPG spell icon with rich painterly brushwork, convincing facial anatomy, dramatic readable silhouette, and polished shipping-game quality.
Square close-up; face fills about 70 percent of the canvas; strongest facial features stay bold and simple; shadow arcs curl inward from all sides; no tiny peripheral storytelling elements; preserve instant legibility when heavily downscaled.
Cold cyan-violet rim light against deep black-purple shadow with a restrained ember-red accent around the mouth or eyes.
Fully opaque edge-to-edge painted background; source-neutral; no caster, recognizable player class, monster species, faction, armor, weapon, or class-bound spell sigil; no text, runes, logos, watermark, border, frame, rounded chrome, UI bevel, or transparent corner.
assets.decision: Accepted after source and 128/40/28/16/13 plus 13px grayscale review.
